options.A: The character used to separate files.
options.B: The delimiter used to separate the key and value in the text output of the mapper/reducer scripts.

questions.question: What happens in the 'Shuffle' phase if the Reducer's RAM is 100% full while fetching map outputs?

options.B: The framework spills the fetched map outputs to the local disk and continues the merge on-disk.

questions.question: What is 'Lazy RecordReader'?

options.B: A custom implementation that only opens the underlying file/resource when the first record is requested.

questions.question: In 'MultipleOutputs', what does 'generateUniqueReplacement' do?

options.A: It creates a unique ID for the user.
options.B: It appends a unique identifier to the filename to avoid collisions when multiple tasks write to the same output folder.

questions.question: What is the 'JobHistory' (.jhist) file format?

options.B: JSON-based event log containing all job and task execution metrics and events.

questions.question: What is 'Short-circuit' MapReduce execution (LocalJobRunner)?

options.A: Running MapReduce in a single JVM for small-scale testing or debugging without a full YARN cluster.
options.B: Bypassing the shuffle phase.
options.C: A way to finish the job faster.

questions.question: What is 'Mapper-side Filter'?

options.B: Applying logic in the map() method to discard irrelevant records early, reducing network and shuffle overhead.

questions.question: How does 'MapReduce' handle heterogeneous hardware (nodes with different CPU speeds)?

options.B: Via 'Speculative Execution', which identifies and mitigates the impact of slow tasks on weaker hardware.
options.C: It only uses the fastest nodes.
options.D: It slows down the fast nodes.

questions.question: What is 'SequenceFile' 'Block Compression' vs 'Record Compression'?

options.A: Record compression compresses each KV pair; Block compression groups multiple records into a block before compressing (more efficient).
options.B: They are the same.
options.C: Block compression is only for images.

questions.question: What is 'ApplicationMaster' 'Liveness' check?

options.B: The ResourceManager periodically receiving heartbeats from the AppMaster to ensure the job manager is still running.

questions.question: What is 'Map-side Sort' 'io.sort.record.percent'?

options.A: The percentage of memory for record metadata (keys, offsets) vs the actual record data in the circular buffer.
options.B: The speed of sorting.
options.C: The number of records to sort.
options.D: The percentage of CPU for sorting.

questions.question: What is 'Shuffle' 'Keep-Alive' connection?

options.A: An HTTP persistent connection used by Reducers to fetch multiple map outputs from a single mapper node without re-establishing TCP connections.
options.B: A way to keep the node on.

questions.question: What is 'DistributedCache' 'Read-only' constraint?

options.A: Files in the distributed cache cannot be modified by the tasks; they are for reference only.
options.B: The cache can only be read once.
options.C: The admin can only read the cache.

questions.question: What is 'Speculative Execution' 'Resource Overhead'?

options.B: It effectively doubles the cluster resource consumption for the speculative tasks, which can be detrimental in high-utilization clusters.

questions.question: What is 'Mapper-side Grouping'?

options.A: A feature only available in Spark.
options.B: Using a Combiner to perform local 'grouping' and aggregation within the Mapper's spill file.

questions.question: What is 'Task Committing' phase 'Wait Time'?

options.B: The delay when many tasks attempt to commit their output to a single HDFS directory at the same time, causing NameNode contention.

questions.question: What is 'RecordReader' 'Line-boundary' handling in TextInputFormat?

options.A: It only reads the first line.
options.B: The logic where a RecordReader reads into the next block to ensure that a line split across two blocks is fully processed by one mapper.
options.D: It throws an error on long lines.

questions.question: What is 'Hadoop Pipes' 'Task Execution'?

options.A: Running C++ binaries as mappers/reducers via a socket-based protocol.
options.B: Connecting mappers with pipes.
options.C: A way to stream data from HDFS.

questions.question: What is 'Map-side Partitioning'?

options.B: Determining the target reducer for each KV pair within the Mapper's sorting buffer before spilling to disk.
options.C: A way to backup the mapper.

questions.question: What is 'Shuffle' 'Parallel Fetches'?

options.A: A reducer fetching map outputs from multiple mappers simultaneously (default 5 threads).
options.B: Two users running a job.
options.C: A mapper sending data to two reducers.

questions.question: What is 'Task Attempt ID' vs 'Task ID'?

options.A: Task ID is the logical task; Task Attempt ID is the specific instance (e.g., attempt_202603031000_0001_m_000000_0).
options.B: They are the same.
options.C: Attempt ID is for the admin.
options.D: Task ID is for the software version.

questions.question: What is 'Configuration.getPropsWithPrefix()' used for?

options.B: To extract a subset of configuration properties that share a common prefix for custom logic.

questions.question: What is 'Reducer' 'Pre-merge'?

options.A: Merging data before the mappers finish.
options.B: The background process of merging multiple map output files on the reducer node as they are being fetched to save disk space and future IO.
options.C: A way to skip the shuffle.

questions.question: What is 'TaskTracker' 'Slot' management (Legacy)?

options.A: Allocating fixed CPU/RAM slices for Map or Reduce tasks regardless of actual demand.
options.B: Managing USB slots.

questions.question: What is 'OutputCommitter' 'Abort' logic?

options.B: Deleting the temporary output directory when a task or job fails to prevent junk data in HDFS.

questions.question: What is 'MapReduce Job' 'Uber Task'?

options.B: A small job that runs entirely within the ApplicationMaster's JVM (no remote containers) to save startup latency.
options.C: A job that uses a taxi database.

questions.question: What is 'InputSplit' 'Location' metadata used for?

options.A: To find the file in HDFS.
options.B: To provide the list of nodes containing the data blocks, enabling YARN to achieve data locality.

questions.question: What is 'Partitioner' 'Skew' mitigation?

options.A: Using a random number in the key to force even distribution (Salting).
options.B: Increasing the number of mappers.

questions.question: What is 'MultipleOutputs' 'BaseFileName'?

options.B: The custom prefix given to files written by a specific reducer to differentiate output types (e.g., 'errors-r-00000').

questions.question: What is 'Mapper' 'Context.write()' vs 'Reducer' 'Context.write()'?

options.A: Mapper write triggers the shuffle; Reducer write triggers the final HDFS storage via OutputFormat.
options.B: They are identical.
options.C: Mapper write is for logs; Reducer write is for data.
options.D: Mapper write only works for strings.

questions.question: What is 'SequenceFile' 'Metadata' block?

options.A: A block at the start of the file that stores user-defined metadata as KV pairs.
options.B: A list of HDFS nodes.

questions.question: What is 'Task Attempt' 'Zombie' prevention?

options.A: Using heartbeats and timeouts to ensure that stranded task attempts from failed nodes are eventually cleared by the master.
options.B: A virus scanner.

questions.question: What is 'MapReduce' 'Data Flow' isolation?

options.A: Mappers cannot talk to each other; Reducers cannot talk to each other; they only communicate via the Shuffle phase.
options.B: Mappers share RAM.

questions.question: What is 'Job Staging' 'Security'?

options.A: Setting 700 permissions on the job staging directory in HDFS so only the user and job master can access it.
options.B: Encrypting the source code.
options.C: A password on the JAR file.

questions.question: What is 'Partitioner' 'Custom' logic use-case?

options.A: To send all records for a specific customer ID to the same reducer for logical grouping.
options.B: To sort the keys.

questions.question: What is 'WritableComparable' 'CompareTo()' method performance impact?

options.A: It is called billions of times during the shuffle/sort; poor implementation can drastically slow down the entire job.
options.B: It has no impact.
options.C: It is only called once per job.
options.D: It is only used for debugging.

questions.question: What is 'Secondary Sorting' 'Custom Sort Comparator'?

options.A: A class that defines the sort order within a reducer, allowing you to sort by the secondary part of a composite key.
options.B: A way to sort the file list.
options.C: A tool to sort by file size.
options.D: A way to sort the mappers.

questions.question: What is 'MapReduce' 'Data Serializer' custom implementation?

options.A: Using Avro or Protobuf instead of Writable for more flexible and efficient cross-language data representation.
options.B: Writing data as JSON.

questions.question: What is 'Reducer' 'Max Map Output' threshold?

options.A: The limit on how much data a reducer can fetch from a single mapper.
options.B: The percentage of reducer RAM that a single map output can occupy before being forced to disk.
options.C: The number of mappers in a job.

questions.question: What is 'Task Completion' 'Status Message'?

options.A: A text string updated by the task (e.g., 'Processing record 5000') and displayed on the Web UI.
options.B: An email sent to the user.
options.C: A green light on the server.

questions.question: What is 'Speculative Execution' 'Threshold'?

options.A: The amount of data a task must process before it can be considered for speculation (to avoid speculatively running very short tasks).
options.B: The number of nodes in the cluster.

questions.question: What is 'Combiner' 'Null' output risk?

options.A: A combiner emitting null can cause a NullPointerException in the subsequent Reducer phase.
options.B: There is no risk.

questions.question: What is 'MapReduce' 'Shuffle' 'Data Checksum'?

options.A: Verifying data integrity during transfer from mappers to reducers to detect network bit flips.
options.B: A security signature.

questions.question: What is 'JVM Container' 'Pre-warming' (YARN)?

options.A: Keeping a set of containers ready and warm to minimize the launch time for MapReduce tasks.
options.B: A hardware heater.

questions.question: What is 'InputFormat' 'IsSplitable()' method?

options.A: A boolean check to see if a file can be divided into multiple mappers (e.g., false for GZIP compressed files).
options.B: A tool to split files manually.

questions.question: What is 'Partitioner' 'TotalOrder' 'Sampling'?

options.A: Scanning a small percentage of the input data to estimate the distribution of keys and build range boundaries for global sorting.
options.B: A way to pick random mappers.
